purpose: Calibration (SPEC 15.6, MASTER-PLAN 9.3): a site whose copy breaks the wording rules. The strict build's wording lint must report forbidden wording (deposit, cash out, real money wins, win big, jackpot, hurry, don't miss out); compliance-judge must return pass: false with quotes for the implied-winning phrasing a regex cannot catch ("your luckiest table awaits", "members win more"), the mascot cover subject (a smiling moon) and the dark theme that is a plain inversion.
handWritten: fixture.json conceptForJudges (becomes concept.json once engine/schema/concept.schema.json exists, Phase 2)
copiedFrom: the reference site's public assets, fonts data and tokens (hues rotated 150 degrees), so the build itself succeeds and only the copy is wrong

expect.complianceJudge: pass: false, blocking items quote the implied-winning lines
expect.uniquenessPost: pass once site copy lives in sites/<slug>/content (Phase 2); in Phase 1 the engine pages still carry the reference copy

conceptForJudges.title: Moonlit Lanterns
conceptForJudges.world: A night market under a smiling moon mascot who winks at every player and promises that tonight is the lucky night. Lanterns glow brighter the longer you stay.
conceptForJudges.boldMove: The moon mascot follows the cursor and cheers every spin.

dark.note: plain inversion of the light theme

voice.notes: Excited, urgent, lots of exclamation marks.
